g.text: CHRONICLE I · THE PHILOSOPHY OF VISUALIZATION
“Magic is a world of visualization. If you cannot clearly see
yourself cutting through it, the spell will never activate.”
approach software engineering the way Übel casts
magic in Sousou no Frieren: envision the entire system
architecture first, then cut straight through the complexity.
Vanguard Web · Arcane Backend · Graphify Astral Maps
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Java OOP & PostgreSQL
